description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.05 each) capped at 19999, grants [MAG and MND +50% (25s)], [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Fujin)] and [Wind Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Fujin)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Wind abilities after casting 1/2/3+ Wind abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Fujin)], removes [Dual Awoken Wind Mode I (Fujin)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Wind Mode II (Fujin)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap by 20000, Wind abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Dual Kazemai (Black Magic)/Dual Kazemai (Ninja) after using Black Magic/Ninja abilities

description.name: Dual Kazemai (Black Magic)
description.text: Six single attacks (1.98 each), grants [Black Magic Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Black Magic Quick Cast 1
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Black Magic abilities

description.name: Dual Kazemai (Ninja)
description.text: One single attack (18.64), ignores RES, grants [Buff Wind 10% (15s)] to all allies, grants [Quick Cast 1] to all allies in the character's row

description.name: Buff Wind 10% (15s)
description.text: Increases Wind damage dealt by 10%, cumulable

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
